name: 共用會議詞庫與編輯視窗
requiresDatabases: Project-local PostgreSQL central_archive meeting workspace and glossary tables
requiresEnv: Existing service-local LINE login and database settings
definitionOfDone: Authenticated vocabulary window and standalone web page
Canonical terms, confusing spellings and context shared across meetings in the same service
No automatic publication of private meeting or tenant dictionary contents
Primary recognition, summary and audio fallback use one vocabulary snapshot
Version conflicts, alias collisions, disable and change audit verified
Prior minutes, transcripts, recordings and task receipts preserved
Actual production verification required before Deployed
